name: Affinitive Starveil
introduction:
◆ Event Details ◆
● During the event, Trailblazers can log in to select one Affinitive Eidolon from the following 5-star characters:
Jing Yuan, Dan Heng • Imbibitor Lunae, or Acheron.
● After claiming the reward, Trailblazers can activate it at the corresponding character's Eidolon screen.
● Once activated, the corresponding character will gain new ability effects and visuals.
